title: The specified left native chain edge 3
statement: For finite R, p:X→Y and P,Q, the original native left chain map number 3 equals the corresponding projection of the explicitly constructed tuple of left paths. This is an equality before degree evaluation, with exactly the native map and its native cochain types.

proof.text: Project component 3 of the explicit tuple. This reduces definitionally to exactly the original native map, so reflexivity proves the equality in Lean. No degree or underlying total object is expanded.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorNativeLeft_edge3
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ) :
    (uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)).map₂HomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app P)
          ((finiteScalarComplexPullbackComparison R p).inv.app Q)) =
    (finiteScalarTensorNativeLeftPaths R p P Q).2.2
